cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena, often described as the source of all things and the path to harmony.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a metaphysical and cosmic dimension beyond ordinary human understanding.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express or articulate something verbally.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used in contexts involving communication or discourse.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way is the explanation of its origin.|He spoke his words, but no one responded.|To speak his words, yet people do not listen.|Govern them with virtue and regulate them with rites.
cards.Sentences: 道者，言其所由也。|子道其言，而人不應。|道其言，而人不聽。|道之以德，齊之以禮。
